trap.label: falso cognato
trap.wrong: The review is not without flaws, but the critic was very sympathetic.
trap.right: The review is not without flaws, but the critic was very kind.
trap.why: “Simpático” não é sympathetic; sympathetic é compassivo.

fix.wrong: It is not without flaw, but it works.
fix.right: It is not without flaws, but it works.

fix.wrong: At her best, illustrate with examples.
fix.right: At her best, she illustrates with examples.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com litote: “It has some flaws.”
Reescreva no passado: “She illustrates the point.”
